description: Final states of programs that finish normally.

cases.name: assignment-creates-variable
cases.source: begin x := 5 end

cases.name: assignment-reads-old-value
cases.description: The right side is evaluated in the old state.
cases.source: begin x := x + 1 end

cases.name: unrelated-variables-are-kept
cases.description: Other variables stay in the state.
cases.source: begin x := 1 end

cases.name: sequence-order
cases.source: begin x := 1; y := x + 1; x := y * 10 end

cases.name: negative-results
cases.source: begin x := x - 10 end

cases.name: condition-truth-table
cases.source: begin if 1 = 1 then a := 1 else a := 0; if 1 = 2 then b := 1 else b := 0; if 2 > 1 then c := 1 else c := 0; if 1 > 2 then d := 1 else d := 0; if ¬1 = 2 then e := 1 else e := 0; if 1 = 2 ∨ 2 > 1 then f := 1 else f := 0; if 1 = 2 ∨ 1 > 2 then g := 1 else g := 0; if ¬(1 = 2 ∨ 1 > 2) then h := 1 else h := 0 end

cases.name: greater-is-strict
cases.source: begin if x > y then r := 1 else r := 0 end

cases.name: if-then-branch
cases.source: begin if x > 0 then a := 1 else b := 1 end

cases.name: if-else-branch
cases.source: begin if x > 0 then a := 1 else b := 1 end

cases.name: nested-if-outer-false

cases.name: nested-if-inner-false
cases.source: begin if a > b then if c > d then x := 1 else x := 2 else x := 3 end

cases.name: if-priority
cases.description: The else branch is one statement; 'b := 3' always runs.
cases.source: begin if x > 0 then a := 1 else a := 2; b := 3 end

cases.name: while-zero-iterations
cases.description: A false condition skips the loop.
cases.source: begin while x > 0 do x := x - 1 end

cases.name: while-countdown
cases.source: begin while x > 0 do x := x - 1 end

cases.name: while-priority
cases.description: The loop body is one statement; 'y := y + 1' runs once, after the loop.
cases.source: begin while x > 0 do x := x - 1; y := y + 1 end

cases.name: while-block-sum
cases.description: Sum of 1..N with a block body.
cases.source: begin S := 0; I := 1; while ¬I > N do begin S := S + I; I := I + 1 end end

cases.name: blocks-and-skip
cases.source: begin begin skip end; begin x := 1; y := 2 end end
